preconditions.description: The number of game pieces is between 1 and 500,000.
The strength of each piece is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: Each character in the team assignment string is 'A' or 'B'
preconditions.description: The team assignment string consists of 'A' and 'B' characters.

postconditions.expression: a == max(sum(p_i for i in range(n) if team_assignment[i] == 'A'), sum(p_i for i in range(n) if team_assignment[i] == 'B'))
postconditions.description: Bob's maximum achievable strength is determined by comparing the sum of strengths of pieces assigned to Alice and Bob after Bob's possible flip.
